n = int(input())
k = int(input())
p = int(input())

MAXN = (1 << 19) | 5
maxn = 0
count_bits = [0] * MAXN
f_vals = [0] * MAXN
tmp1_tmp = [[0] * MAXN for _ in range(20)]
tmp2_tmp = [[0] * MAXN for _ in range(20)]
tmp3_tmp = [[0] * MAXN for _ in range(20)]
trans = [[0] * MAXN for _ in range(20)]
fact_arr = [0] * MAXN
inv_fact_arr = [0] * MAXN

total_pow = 0

def power(base, exp):
    res = 1
    cur = base
    while exp > 0:
        if exp & 1:
            res = res * cur % p
        cur = cur * cur % p
        exp >>= 1
    return res

def setup():
    fact_arr[0] = 1
    for i in range(1, maxn + 1):
        fact_arr[i] = fact_arr[i - 1] * i % p
    inv_fact_arr[maxn] = power(fact_arr[maxn], p - 2)
    for i in range(maxn - 1, -1, -1):
        inv_fact_arr[i] = inv_fact_arr[i + 1] * (i + 1) % p

def get_lower_power(x):
    res = 1
    while res < x:
        res <<= 1
    return res

def FWT(arr, length, inv=False):
    temp = arr[:]
    step = 1
    while step < length:
        for j in range(0, length, step << 1):
            for k in range(j, j + step):
                val = temp[k]
                if inv:
                    temp[k + step] -= val
                else:
                    temp[k + step] += val
        step <<= 1
    for i in range(length):
        arr[i] = temp[i] % p

def mod_adjust(x):
    if x >= total_pow:
        x -= total_pow

def do_multiply():
    for i in range(maxn + 1):
        for q in range(20):
            tmp1_tmp[q][i] = 0
    for i in range(maxn + 1):
        count_bits[i] = bin(i).count('1')
        for q in range(20):
            tmp1_tmp[q][i] = f_vals[i] if q == count_bits[i] else tmp1_tmp[q][i]
    for q in range(20):
        FWT(tmp1_tmp[q], maxn + 1)
    for q in range(20):

            for s in range(maxn + 1):
                trans[q + l][s] += tmp1_tmp[q][s] * tmp2_tmp[l][s]
                trans[q + l][s] %= p
    for q in range(20):
        for s in range(maxn + 1):
            tmp3_tmp[q][s] = trans[q][s]
    for q in range(20):

    for j in range(maxn + 1):
        f_vals[j] = tmp3_tmp[count_bits[j]][j]

def do_alt_multiply():
    for i in range(20):
        for s in range(maxn + 1):
            trans[i][s] = 0
    for q in range(20):
        for l in range(20 - q):
            for s in range(maxn + 1):
                trans[q + l][s] += tmp2_tmp[q][s] * tmp2_tmp[l][s]
                trans[q + l][s] %= p
    for q in range(20):
        for s in range(maxn + 1):
            tmp = trans[q][s]
            tmp2_tmp[q][s] = tmp
    for i in range(20):
        FWT(tmp2_tmp[i], maxn + 1, inv=True)
    for i in range(20):
        for s in range(maxn + 1):
            tmp2_tmp[i][s] = 0
    for i in range(maxn + 1):
        q = bin(i).count('1')
        tmp2_tmp[q][i] = tmp2_tmp[q][i]

# Read input
n = int(input())
k = int(input())
p = int(input())

total_pow = p * p

if n & 1:

f_vals[0] = 1

for i in range(maxn + 1):

for i in range(maxn + 1):
    q = count_bits[i]
    tmp2_tmp[q][i] = inv_fact_arr[i]

for i in range(20):

res_k = k
while res_k:
    if res_k & 1:
        do_multiply()
    res_k >>= 1
    if res_k:
        do_alt_multiply()

result = (power(k, n) - fact_arr[n] * f_vals[n] % p + p) % p
print(result)
